# openwebui_skill (Resource)

Manages a skill in Open WebUI. A skill is a Markdown document that models load as extra instructions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Markdown body of the skill.
- `name` (String) Display name of the skill. Unique across the Open WebUI instance.
- `skill_id` (String) Unique identifier for the skill, e.g. `code-review`. Must be lowercase and free of spaces, because Open WebUI rewrites anything else. Forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Short description shown in the Open WebUI interface.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the skill is available to models. Defaults to `true`.
- `public_read` (Boolean) Whether every signed-in user can read the skill. This is the sharing the web UI calls public.
- `public_write` (Boolean) Whether every signed-in user can write the skill.
- `read_groups` (List of String) List of group names or IDs granted read access.
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags for categorising the skill.
- `write_groups` (List of String) List of group names or IDs granted write access.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of creation. Set by Open WebUI.
- `id` (String) Identifier assigned by Open WebUI on create.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of last update. Set by Open WebUI.
- `user_id` (String) Owner user identifier. Set by Open WebUI.
- `write_access` (Boolean) Whether the authenticated user has write access to this skill. Read-only; set by Open WebUI.
